answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the lantern of a task receipt, and the orchard is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, no identity may audit its own recruit. The terrace of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
